ValidationRule.description: PacPoint-IC073019- Created for PVL phase 1 Stop the users from having both the Dependent Application & Dependent License populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( DependentApplication__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( DependentLicense__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Dependent Application and Dependent License shouldn't be populated at the same time.
